538:t_2:59.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「And so they came to call themselves gods.」

538:t_2:61.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「But a god does not tolerate other gods. Thus gods are destined to fight gods... That is the universe's True War...」

538:t_2:62.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「To win it, I must rise to greater heights by absorbing you, a being beyond causality.」

538:t_2:63.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Do you think I will obey?」

538:t_2:64.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「To ensure it, I changed that woman's fate.」

538:t_2:67.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「That is correct. Originally, that woman was fated to die.」

538:t_2:68.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「But with my power, I revived that woman and permitted her to live on.」

538:t_2:69.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「Admit it, $$キリコ$$. I am a being who controls even fate... a god.」

538:t_2:70.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「If you wish to protect that woman, submit quietly to my will.」

538:t_2:72.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「Yes, $$キリコ$$. That is the fate you cannot resist.」

538:t_2:74.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「I shall say it once more, $$キリコ$$. I am a being who controls even fate.」

538:t_2:77.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Heh heh... You live up to your reputation, $$キリコ$$. You made it this far.」

538:t_2:78.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「$$ロッチナ$$... You are my eyes and ears. Why are you here?」

538:t_2:79.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「$$ワイズマン#pilot$$... Are you truly a being who governs fate?」

538:t_2:81.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Of course, I too worshipped you as a god... I believe I know your power.」

538:t_2:82.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「I also know you transported yourself and the people of $$アストラギウス$$ to this Earth, the center of all causality.」

538:t_2:83.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$ワイズマン#pilot$$ transported us here?」

538:t_2:84.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「That is correct. The destruction of Planet $$モナド$$, which you know of, was an experiment in $$時空震動$$.」

538:t_2:85.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「Using that data, I transported chosen people and myself to this galaxy, where myth will likely end.」

538:t_2:86.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「That power defies imagination... You certainly deserve to be called a god...」

538:t_2:87.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「But you too have been drawn in by $$キリコ$$. Just as I was.」

538:t_2:89.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「It is true that you saved $$フィアナ$$'s life. But $$キリコ$$'s existence was what determined that action.」

538:t_2:90.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「And to contact $$キリコ$$, you chose the ambitious $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$ and set $$マーティアル$$ in motion.」

538:t_2:91.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「In other words, your fate is being driven by the being called $$キリコ$$.」

538:t_2:92.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「That is impossible...! I am... a god... a being who transcends all things!」

538:t_2:94.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「$$キリコ$$ rejects your existence, but you need his... Master and servant have already traded places.」

538:t_2:96.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$ロッチナ$$ is right, $$ワイズマン#pilot$$. I reject your existence.」

538:t_2:97.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「Stop, $$キリコ$$! What are you doing!?」

538:t_2:98.en:
$$キリコ$$
「This time, I will destroy you for good.」

538:t_2:99.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「I saved your woman! So why...!」

538:t_2:100.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Before that, you toyed with my fate and $$フィアナ$$'s. And now you are trying to bend me to your will again.」

538:t_2:101.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「Why!? Why will you not obey me!」

538:t_2:102.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「With your power added to mine, victory in the True War and overcoming the future of despair would be more than dreams!」

538:t_2:103.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Your dreams have nothing to do with me.」

538:t_2:104.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I will help, $$キリコ$$.」

538:t_2:105.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$テイタニア$$. Take care of $$フィアナ$$ for me.」

538:t_2:106.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「$$フィアナ$$... You were alive.」

538:t_2:107.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「She is asleep at the moment.」

538:t_2:108.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「You damned $$ネクスタント$$...! Obey my command!」

538:t_2:109.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I no longer have an auxiliary brain.」

538:t_2:110.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「And I am not a $$ネクスタント$$. I am... human!」

538:t_2:111.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「It is impossible...! It is impossible... impossible!」

538:t_2:112.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$ワイズマン#pilot$$. Go to sleep now.」

538:t_3:7.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「There is no need to worry. $$フィアナ$$ will gradually revive like this.」

538:t_3:8.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Her consciousness is already approaching wakefulness. If you speak to her, your words should reach her.」

538:t_3:9.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I never expected you to side with us.」

538:t_3:10.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「I am an impartial observer. I neither favor nor oppose him. I merely watch where $$キリコ・キュービィー$$ goes.」

538:t_3:11.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$ワイズマン#pilot$$ is dead. What do you intend to do now?」

538:t_3:12.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Do you truly believe God is dead?」

538:t_3:14.en:
$$カレン$$
「Hey! Are you trying to threaten $$キリコ$$ like that!?」

538:t_3:15.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「I have no such intention. I said that because even I do not know the full extent of $$ワイズマン#pilot$$'s power.」

538:t_3:16.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Are you saying he has done something like he did on $$クエント$$?」

538:t_3:17.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「I am saying it is possible.」

538:t_3:18.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I have no intention of believing in a future of despair.」

538:t_3:19.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We feel the same as $$キリコ$$. Whatever awaits in the future, we are prepared to face it.」

538:t_3:20.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「What $$ワイズマン#pilot$$ told $$キリコ$$ also gives us a vague idea of what these beings called gods are.」

538:t_3:21.en:
$n
「They are beings beyond humanity... higher-dimensional life-forms...」

538:t_3:22.en:
$$アルト$$
「So beings like that are the ones who gave us the $$烙印$$...」

538:t_3:24.en:
$$宗介$$
「If those beings are connected to the future of despair, what does the fundamental calamity we met at the galaxy's center mean?」

538:t_3:26.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But if the true collapse that comes once every 120 million years is approaching, we will eventually face it.」

538:t_3:27.en:
$$桂$$
「Even so, we don't have to fear it.」

538:t_3:28.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Now that we've made up our minds, we'll shake off our doubts and fears and keep moving.」

kept_omissions: 538:t_2:99: Wiseman trails off after asking why Chirico attacks despite saving Fyana.
